correctness.rationale: Radial Hermite STFT diagonalization gives the exact eigenvalue integral with Poisson mass times Charlier squared C_k(n;u)^2/(k!u^k). Fixed-k Stirling expansion yields leading e^(−x²/2)H_k(x)^2/k! and first correction F1. The Charlier generating function e^(uv)(1−v)^n gives D=−xH″/2+H‴/3. Applying Hermite differential equation proves the exact identity F1=−xF0/6−(x²+2k−2)H(2H′−xH)/(6k!), and at a nonzero positive critical point 2H′=xH. Nondegenerate peaks persist with O(1) lattice index displacement; discrete rounding contributes only relative O(R^−1). For k=2, G2=e^(−x²/2)(x²−1)^2/2 has global peaks ±√5 exceeding the central peak 0, and Poisson large-deviation tails exclude other indices. Independent Sympy checked the identity at k=1...9, and independent quadrature finds the left peak larger at R=150,500,1500 with the scaled gap approaching the stated coefficient. These finite checks are corroboration, not all-k proof.
